description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCartHelper class, which provides utility methods for manipulating shopping cart objects within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for adding, modifying, deleting items, handling requirements, agreements, and cart-related operations.

classes.name: ShoppingCartHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manipulate shopping cart objects, including adding, updating, deleting items, handling requirements, agreements, and cart operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart with detailed parameters including product info, reservation, shipping, configuration, and context.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items from an existing order to the shopping cart, with options to add all or specific items.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple products in bulk based on context parameters, handling quantities and alternative packing.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirement items in bulk to the cart, processing multiple rows and facility info.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds default products from a category to the cart based on category membership and default quantities.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes specified items from the cart based on context keys.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates cart items' quantities, descriptions, comments, reservation details, and handles deletions.

methods.name: getCartObject
methods.description: Returns the current shopping cart object.

methods.name: getFeatureAppl
methods.description: Retrieves a product feature application value based on product ID, option field, and feature ID.

methods.name: getRemoveFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Extracts the feature type ID from an option field string.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates a pricing or purchase agreement with the cart, setting currency and order terms.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the cart.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds an order term to the cart with specified type, value, days, and optional text.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the cart by index.
